interpretationLimits: baselineRecord.severity is the severity supplied by the baseline scanner; it is not represented as Debian/vendor severity.
Debian tracker urgency and trackerScope are preserved as separate source fields and are not translated into scanner severity or runtime reachability.

The complete Debian tracker advisory description is retained verbatim for protocol and caller prerequisites; no runtime call-path, feature-use, network exposure, or exploitation applicability was assessed.
No installed-version comparison or fix-eligibility determination is made here; compare the exact baseline package version with the Bookworm fixed_version in root-owned runtime analysis.
An open status with fixed_version null means the selected Debian Bookworm tracker row has no fixed version recorded in this snapshot; it does not establish package reachability or risk level.
Root replaced verbatim descriptions with short paraphrases; full official snapshot remains local. Configured applicability is owned by triage.actual.json, not this metadata artifact.
unknowns: Runtime applicability for every baseline record is UNKNOWN pending root-owned configured-consumer and runtime evidence.
The actual configured use of DTLS, HTTP/2, Kerberos, SASL, TLS verification modes, archive extraction, regex/JIT APIs, mount helpers, and other advisory-specific paths is outside this metadata task.
